profile.name: Khuong Nguyen Huu
profile.headline: Building enterprise web applications with Angular, Vue.js and TypeScript.
profile.shortSummary: Senior Front-end Engineer with over 8 years of experience building enterprise web applications. I work across frontend architecture, reusable components, responsive and cross-browser interfaces, feature delivery, code review and technical mentoring.
profile.summary:
Senior Front-end Engineer with over 8 years of experience in building enterprise web applications using Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3.

Experienced in frontend architecture, responsive web design, cross-browser compatibility, reusable component development, code review and technical mentoring within Agile environments.

Strong background in leading frontend feature delivery and collaborating with cross-functional teams across government, retail, education and e-commerce domains.

Actively leverage AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to accelerate development, testing, debugging and documentation.
